content: This is one of the greatest Indian snack/dish that I know. It is not just my favorite, it is loved by zillions of people around the universe. I know people on Mars who order this from Bikanerwala every weekend. And you thought that Big Mac was a big deal. Watch out foodies, this is THE REAL DEAL!!!
